raw_text: Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker. Build: `mvn clean package`; `mvn -pl user-service -am package`; run: `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; jar: `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; stack: `docker compose up --build`. Tests: `mvn test`; `mvn -pl order-service test`. Paths: `<module>/src/main/java`, `<module>/src/main/resources/application.yml`, `<module>/src/test/java`; root `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`. Use JUnit 5 and Spring Boot testing support (`spring-boot-starter-test`) when introducing tests. Add new tests under `<module>/src/test/java`. Conventions: `*Test`, `*IT`. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables for credentials.
